entry.title: Open303 1.2.1
entry.summary: TB-303 bass line: Open303 with the Devilfish mods, a drive stage and 13 presets. ## What's new in 1.2.1 Built on sd88me's fixed wrapper ([mpc-vst-plugins#499](https://github.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins/discussions/499)): on track edit → automation, the physical Q-Links move this plugin's parameters again (before, they didn't move or snapped straight back). Controls that change others, such as a preset, still redraw the screen. Nothing else changed: same parameters, sound and screen, and saved pro

entry.title: Open303 1.2.0
entry.summary: TB-303 bass line: Open303 with the Devilfish mods, a drive stage and 13 presets. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. Installing plugins this way is unofficial: back up first, use at your own risk. ## Instal
